brief: A sturdy step for my toddler to stand on so they can reach the bathroom sink.

requirements.evidence: 7 full bases (piece:0,0,0;full + 6 ring) with full top covers form a 507x549mm platform, 80mm high; top view verified, meshClash clear.
requirements.requirement: Platform a toddler can stand on to gain height at the sink

requirements.evidence: Wide 7-cell single-storey body, one group, capOpenFaces + lockJoints applied (12 joint bolts, 18 end caps); check_build ok, meshClash clear.
Single storey = 80mm boost only; system cannot vary layer height. No anti-slip texture, load rating, waterproofing or food/heat safety is checked by the configurator.
requirements.requirement: Safe and effective in a bathroom for toddler use

finish.summary: Built a wide, low 7-hex standing platform (80mm high) with closed top covers, capped edges and locked joints. It gives a stable 8cm boost; load strength, slip resistance and water suitability are not verified by the configurator and remain with the user's material choice and supervision.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
